name: Pound Puppies
s: Pound Puppies was inspired by the Tonka Toys line and centers on 11-year old Holly and her dog friends Cooler, Whopper, Nose Marie, and Howler at the Wagga Wagga Pound who work hard to find happy homes for dogs. They are opposed by Brattina and Katrina, along with Catgut and Nabbit. The series began with a one-hour special in 1985 on ABC. The Pound Puppies consisted of 13 episodes, aired Saturday …

paragraphs.text: Pound Puppies (known as All New Pound Puppies in its second season) is an American animated series made by Hanna-Barbera Productions and based on the toyline by Tonka, and acts as the sequel to the 1985 television special. Broadcast on ABC from September 13, 1986 until December 19, 1987, the franchise was rebooted for the 2010 series. 26 episodes (36 segments in total) were produced.
